title: Six niche starter kits for the Designer theme, and Designer on the /themes gallery
detail: Follows LIVE-1490. lib/sites/kits/designer-variants.ts builds coaches, studios, hosts, venues, nonprofits and networks kits from the shared niche words (niche-spec.ts) in Designer blocks plus the live Space blocks, registered in registry.ts so the editor's Starter kits panel and the Change theme dialog list them and the /themes gallery card shows them. Generic copy, no prices, photos or real names. The gallery lede now says seven looks.
